verdict.rationale: Semgrep has no documented sandbox environment, but it offers safe ways to experiment without affecting real platform data. The `--dry-run` flag keeps scans from being uploaded to the Semgrep web app, scans run locally without login, and the rule-testing mechanism and Semgrep Editor let you test rules in isolation. Missing for 10: a dedicated sandbox or test org/tenant for the AppSec Platform and API, documented isolation of test findings from production findings, and independent or hands-on corroboration of sandbox-style workflows.
